text: The identity card was harder. Photographs of the dead man looked exactly like what they were. So the team searched for a living man who resembled him, and found one inside MI5: Captain Ronnie Reed, who agreed to be photographed in a Royal Marine uniform. Montagu then spent weeks rubbing the cards against his trousers, so they would look worn.
